package main

  "github.com/mattn/anko/env"
  "github.com/mattn/anko/parser"
  "github.com/mattn/anko/vm"
)
func main(){
  e:=env.NewEnv()
  src := `func makeAdder(a = 1) { return func(b = a) { return a + b } }; f = makeAdder(10); f()`

  v,err:=vm.Run(e,nil,st); fmt.Printf("%#v %v\n",v,err)
}
EOF
go run /tmp/test_closure.go

		{Script: "func f(a = [1,\\n2]) { return a[1] }\\nfunc g(b = 5) { return b }; f()", RunOutput: int64(2)},

'''
assert marker in s
s=s.replace(marker,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
